response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile senior individual contributor with 15+ years of hands-on development across web, backend, embedded and open-source projects, plus visible community/teaching activity and a CS degree. However, the role is an executive-level leadership position and the resume shows no formal people-management, no ownership of client portfolios or technical project management, and little evidence of IT architecture design, UML modeling, requirements management, or IT security/compliance work. Most critically, the position requires German at C1 minimum while the candidate lists German as basic, which is a hard blocker for a client-facing consulting lead in the German market. Python is also absent from the skill set.
strengths: Deep, broad hands-on engineering experience (15+ yrs, multiple stacks)
Genuine open-source track record: founder of GISCollective, D-lang libraries, conference talks
Proven mentoring/teaching via workshops, courses and dojos
concerns: German listed as 'Basic' vs. required C1 — hard requirement gap
No formal team-lead, hiring, or P&L/client-portfolio leadership experience
No demonstrated UML/architecture design, requirements management, or IT security/compliance work

key_factors.factor: Lack of leadership / technical project management experience
Strong senior engineering depth and open-source/Linux affinity
